title: NOW — ServiceNow
html:
Close: $149.54 · Day: +2.9% · Week: +7.9% · YTD: −2.4% Trend: back to an uptrend — above the 20-day ($138.93), 50-day ($135.70) and 200-day ($115.01). RSI(14): 63 · ATR(14): about $6.27 a day (~4%) · Volatility: ~40% annualized

Story: software stocks were crushed early in 2026 over fears that AI would replace software seats. NOW fell 58% from its Oct 30, 2025 high ($192.97) to its Apr 10, 2026 low ($81.24). It has rebounded about 84% since, helped by a sector rally after late August and a forward P/E expanding from ~23x to ~31x, while forward earnings rose only ~4% (TIKR). The rally is built more on optimism than on earnings so far.

The levels that matter

  • Right now: pressing the 61.8% golden-ratio level ($150.29) of the whole decline. This is the classic make-or-break level for a rebound.
  • Resistance: $150.29, then the Oct 16 high at $154.20. A close above opens the 78.6% at $169.06.
  • Support — strong cluster: $136–137, where the 50-day ($135.70), the 23.6% of the rebound ($136.98) and the 50% of the decline ($137.10) all line up.

Earnings: Wed Oct 28, 2026 (EPS est. ~$0.35), the same day as the Fed decision. Expect a big move and expensive options going in.

Edge study (20-day, about 4 years): Fib pullbacks in an uptrend won 62.5% (8 events) vs a 56% baseline. Small sample.
